proof_body:
by
  ext n
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivativeFun, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk, Nat.bell_succ]
  have h3 : (n.factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast n.factorial_ne_zero
  have h5 : ((n:ℚ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero n
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => n.choose i * Nat.bell (n - i)) (n+1), Nat.factorial_succ]
  push_cast
  rw [Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  have hi' : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_exp, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, Nat.cast_choose ℚ hi']
  have h1 : (i.factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast i.factorial_ne_zero
  have h2 : ((n - i).factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (n - i).factorial_ne_zero
  simp
  field_simp
target_source: PowerSeries.derivativeFun (PowerSeries.mk (fun n => (Nat.bell n : ℚ) / n.factorial)) = PowerSeries.exp ℚ * PowerSeries.mk (fun n => (Nat.bell n : ℚ) / n.factorial)
